summary.text: Jonathan Nez is the Democratic nominee for Arizona's 2nd Congressional District, running for the seat for a second time after losing to incumbent Eli Crane in 2024. He previously served as president of the Navajo Nation.

paragraphs.text: Born in Tuba City, Arizona, and grew up in Shonto, Arizona. His campaign website says he grew up "on dirt floors without electricity or running water."
Attended Northland Pioneer College and Northern Arizona University, where he earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a Master of Public Administration, according to Wikipedia.

Early in his career he served as vice president of the Navajo Nation's Shonto chapter and as a delegate to the Navajo Nation Council representing the Oljato, Ts'ah Bii' Kin, Navajo Mountain, and Shonto chapters.
Elected vice president of the Navajo Nation in 2015 on a ticket led by Russell Begaye; sworn in May 12, 2015.

Elected president of the Navajo Nation in November 2018 and served from 2019 to 2023, including during the COVID-19 pandemic. He lost his 2022 re-election bid to Buu Nygren. His campaign website says he worked with the Trump administration on water rights for rural Arizona.
Spoke at the 2020 Democratic National Convention and was one of Arizona's presidential electors in 2020, according to Wikipedia.

Was the Democratic nominee for Arizona's 2nd District in 2024, losing to Eli Crane 54.5%-45.5%. Announced a second run on July 22, 2025 and won the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary with 100% of the vote.
